description: A man in a dark long coat and high collar, shown in profile, holds an open book up in one hand toward a glowing light and looks at its pages. Behind him a swirling vortex of dark and amber brushstrokes surrounds a pale light. Smoke rises from industrial chimneys on the right, a dim town skyline with lit windows sits behind him, and two shadowy men in hats stand at the left and right edges. The painting is a square canvas on a pale grey wall, with the wall visible around its edges. A tiny sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner. There is no readable text and nothing gory.
